messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-pool-us-east-1 saturated, autoscaler failed to provision additional nodes (error=RateLimitExceeded). queue_length=1342, avg_latency_tokens=1.1s, throttled_requests=412. Auto-remediation retry scheduled but failing. Paging oncall (alice_oncall).

alice_oncall: acked. Investigating. First look: dashboard shows sustained enqueue while shard headroom is 0/8 GPUs available. Can folks avoid noise while I dig in?

priya_sre: on it -- looking at autoscaler logs, seeing 429s from cloud provider when creating instances. Also several pending 'Provisioning' jobs stuck for >7m.

omar_runtime: noticed a recent spike in long-context requests from a single customer (org_id=org-42) and a batch job from internal test queue that started around 09:12 and never throttled. Could be correlated.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) enable route-level throttling to 10r/s for non-critical routes; 2) engage fallback routing to quantized small model variant to reduce GPU usage; 3) temporarily disable internal test queue autostart. Implementing now.

alice_oncall: runbook commands I'm executing:
```
# reduce concurrency for public routes
redwoodctl routes update --match "public-*" --concurrency 10
# enable fallback model mapping
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --model redwood-quant-7b --route "*" --priority 10
# pause internal test queue
kubectl scale deployment internal-loadgen -n infra --replicas=0
```

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: routing change to enable fallback model (deploy_id=deploy-20240302-09:28). Logs will stream to /deploys/deploy-20240302-09:28.log

priya_sre: autoscaler logs snippet:
```
2024-03-02T09:18:10Z ERROR provisioning: api error: RateLimitExceeded: Request throttled
2024-03-02T09:18:12Z WARN backoff: sleeping 60s
2024-03-02T09:25:45Z ERROR provisioning: api error: InsufficientCapacity: not enough GX instances
```

omar_runtime: I pushed a temporary circuit to route org-42 to a reserved small capacity pool (dedicated-dev-x). org-42 traffic should stop contributing to the public GPU pool within 30s.

alice_oncall: Customer impact estimate so far: increased latencies and 5xxs for generation endpoints. ~12 customers saw elevated error rates; top 3 customers affected (org-42, org-7, org-88). Metrics: error_rate spike +6.7pp, p95 latency from ~220ms -> 1.2s during peak. Documenting in incident tracker.

cs_jordan: CS notif: pinged top 3 customers and created support tickets. org-7 & org-88 acknowledged and accepted temporary reduced throughput. org-42 is internal but may have been running runaway job; reaching out to their SRE.

priya_sre: Workaround status: fallback model reduced GPU pressure by ~46% within 4 minutes; queue draining rate improved. However autoscaler still cannot provision due to provider rate limits/InsufficientCapacity in us-east-1.

alice_oncall: Next short-term steps: 1) enable cross-region spillover to us-west-2 for new requests, 2) request emergency capacity increase with cloud provider support, 3) keep throttles and fallback in place until autoscaler healthy.

omar_runtime: Cross-region spillover config applied:
```
redwoodctl routing add-policy --name cross-region-spill --from-region us-east-1 --to-region us-west-2 --match "*" --priority 5
```
Testing a few requests -- successful and routed to us-west-2 GPUs.

priya_sre: Filed support ticket with provider (case=PROV-98712) asking for mitigation and quota bump. Also flagged as potential capacity shortage in us-east-1.

alice_oncall: Good. Logging timeline in incident tracker. Can someone start drafting a short incident summary for execs and customers? Keep it factual: autoscaler retries hit provider rate limits + regional capacity shortage; mitigations: throttling, fallback models, cross-region spill, paused internal load.

ben_oncall: I can take a handoff in 40m. Will monitor for the next 2h and coordinate with infra. Any open actions to hand off?

alice_oncall: Handoff checklist for ben_oncall: 1) monitor queue length & throttled_requests, 2) validate autoscaler provisioning retries, 3) follow-up with provider case, 4) confirm internal test queues remain paused, 5) coordinate CS on affected customers. Logs + runbook references in tracker: /incidents/1712104523

ben_oncall: acked. I'll pick this up at 10:20 UTC. Leaving throttles & fallback in place. :thumbsup:

cs_jordan: CS will keep org-7 & org-88 updated and send an ETA note once provider responds.

priya_sre: Note: autoscaler code path that batches provisioning requests into a single rate-limited API call needs a retry/backoff improvement. Creating a PR ticket and will include an integration test for provider 429 behavior.

omar_runtime: Small mitigation implemented: limit per-customer long-context token length to 8k during this incident to avoid additional KV growth, applied to org-42 and internal test orgs.

alice_oncall: After mitigations queue length fell to 120 within ~25 minutes. error_rate down to +1.2pp above baseline. Good progress. Keeping incident open until autoscaler healthy and provider confirms capacity.

deploy-bot: Routing change rolled back? No, routing is still active (deploy_id=deploy-20240302-09:28) - no errors reported.

priya_sre: Post-incident action items I'm capturing:
- Fix autoscaler retry/backoff for provider 429s (owner=priya_sre, pr in progress)
- Add metric & alert for prolonged provisioning pending >5m (owner=omar_runtime)
- Implement per-org long-context quotas and runbook step (owner=alice_oncall)
- Add regional capacity fallback test to staging (owner=ben_oncall)
- Update incident runbook with steps for cross-region spill and dedicated-pool quick-assign (owner=alice_oncall)

alice_oncall: Thanks team. Handing off now to ben_oncall. Summary for handoff: autoscaler hit provider rate limits + insufficient capacity in us-east-1 -> triggered queue growth and throttling. Short-term mitigations done (throttles, fallback model, paused internal load, cross-region spill). Next: monitor autoscaler, follow provider case, application-level quotas for heavy customers. Leaving incident channel open for updates.

ben_oncall: taking over. I'll post updates every 20m or on any change. If autoscaler recovers, we can begin rolling back throttles and fallback in controlled steps.

cs_jordan: Filing postmortem template note and adding affected customer list for outreach. Will sync with ben for timeline updates before customer follow-ups.

priya_sre: marking incident severity P1 -> P2 as immediate load improved but root cause still unresolved. Will keep assigned PR and provider ticket active.

alice_oncall: Great work. Closing my active shift on this one. Leaving the channel to ben_oncall. :wave:

ben_oncall: Update 10:40 UTC: provider responded indicating transient regional capacity pressure; they recommend trying again in 30-60m. I'll keep fallback and throttles for at least one more hour, then start controlled rollback if capacity looks healthy.

priya_sre: Adding final note: postmortem meeting scheduled 2024-03-03 16:00 UTC. Invite to SRE, runtime, oncall, product & CS. We'll cover timeline, root cause analysis, and action owners.

ben_oncall: Acknowledged. Will own post-incident remediation tracking and ensure runbook updates land. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
